display.purpose: Home hero headline only; 34px/40px on mobile, 56px/64px from lg.

headline.purpose: Section titles; 24px/30px on mobile, 36px/44px from lg.

title.purpose: Card titles, list item names and button labels.

label.purpose: Geist Mono uppercase eyebrow above a heading.

motion.name: motion-base
motion.purpose: Card hover shadow, border and lift; collapse.

motion.name: motion-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveal below the fold; staggered 60ms.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; background: #E11D48; color: #fff; font: 600 14px/1 Geist, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 100ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #BE123C; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #9F1239; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E11D48; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A neutral alternative next to a primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid #E3D5DA; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #26141A; font: 600 14px/1 Geist, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #FDF8F9; border-color: #A1A1AA; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E11D48; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Soft Button
components.description: A tinted button for supporting actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-soft { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid #E11D48; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFE9EE; color: #9F1239; font: 600 14px/1 Geist, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-soft:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E11D48; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Bar
components.description: The hero search container; the border turns rose when the field has focus.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; padding: 8px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #E3D5DA; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(38, 20, 26, 0.06); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #E11D48; } .ds-search-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: none; padding: 8px 12px; background: transparent; color: #26141A; font: 400 15px/1.4 Geist, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: #85757D; } .ds-search-btn { height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; background: #E11D48; color: #fff; font: 600 15px/1 Geist, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-search-btn:hover { background: #BE123C; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Popular-search shortcut; hover turns the border and text rose.
components.css: .ds-chip { height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #E3D5DA; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; color: #26141A; font: 400 14px/1 Geist, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 150ms, transform 100ms; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #E11D48; color: #9F1239; } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E11D48; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Specialty Card
components.description: Whole-card link with a Blush Tint icon tile; flat at rest, lifts 3px on hover.
components.html: Orthopaedics
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 20px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #EFE3E7; border-radius: 16px; color: #26141A; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), border-color 220ms, transform 220ms; } .ds-card:hover, .ds-card:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgb(38 20 26 / 0.08); border-color: #E11D48; transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E11D48; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-tile { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 12px; background: #FFE9EE; color: #9F1239; flex: none; } .ds-card-title { font: 600 16px/1.4 Geist, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header link; quiet at rest, tinted on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #26141A; font: 500 15px/1.4 Geist, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #E11D48; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E11D48; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A well-run clinic reception: warm, orderly and unhurried. The visitor may be unwell, anxious or booking for a relative, so the interface never shouts. It sits on warm off-white and rose-tinted neutrals, speaks in plain sentences, and puts one clear next step on each screen. The same system serves staff in /admin, where the calm becomes precision.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, rose #E11D48, used rarely and on purpose.
Flat, bordered surfaces at rest; a soft shadow and a 3px lift appear only on hover or focus.
Geist for text, Geist Mono for small uppercase eyebrow labels.
Motion is short, opacity/transform only, and fully switched off under prefers-reduced-motion.
Light and dark themes share one token set.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Rose marks the one action or state that matters on a screen. Most of any page is warm neutral.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a cool gray, slate-blue or pure-black text. Use the remapped gray scale and Plum Ink.

rules.name: The Danger Is Not Brand Rule
rules.body: Destructive and error states use Alert Brick, never Signal Rose.

rules.name: The Weight Over Size Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from 600 vs 400 and from the defined size steps, not from extra sizes.

rules.name: The Mono Is An Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is for short uppercase labels only; never body copy or buttons.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing is raised at rest. Shadow and lift are earned by hover, focus or an open state, never decoration.

dos: Do use .public-container for every public section wrapper.
Do build buttons with boo-button and a variant; use physio-icon for icons.
Do use the remapped warm gray scale and Plum Ink (#26141A) for text.
Do reserve Signal Rose (#E11D48) for the one primary action or state per area.
Do keep surfaces flat with 1px #EFE3E7 borders; add lift and shadow only on hover or focus via .motion-card / .motion-card-lift.
Do give every interactive control the global 2px rose focus ring and a 44px touch target.
Do write copy that describes an appointment as a request the clinic confirms.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for any new animation, using the shared motion tokens.
donts: Don't use the legacy gradient button (rose to cyan #06aed4) outside the auth pages.
Don't introduce cool grays, blue-tinted neutrals or pure black text.
Don't use Signal Rose for destructive states; use Alert Brick (#B42318).
Don't use #A1A1AA for meaningful text: it is for table headers, disabled and decorative text, and is below AA contrast on white.
Don't add shadows to resting cards, or nest cards inside cards.
Don't hard-code max-w-[1200px] mx-auto px-* on public pages.
Don't put Geist Mono in body copy or buttons.
Don't invent testimonials, ratings, patient counts or accreditations.
